incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK usage in AwsS3Service (web)
incidents.description: Direct usage of AWS S3 SDK (software.amazon.awssdk.services.s3.S3Client) for object storage operations
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage using Azure SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob)

incidents.title: AWS S3 SDK usage in S3FileProcessingService (worker)
incidents.description: Direct usage of AWS S3 SDK for thumbnail generation and storage operations in worker module
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Blob Storage using Azure SDK

incidents.title: S3 PutObjectRequest usage
incidents.description: AWS-specific PutObjectRequest for uploading objects
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob upload methods

incidents.title: S3 GetObjectRequest usage
incidents.description: AWS-specific GetObjectRequest for retrieving objects
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob download methods

incidents.title: S3 DeleteObjectRequest usage
incidents.description: AWS-specific DeleteObjectRequest for deleting objects
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob delete methods

incidents.title: S3 ListObjectsV2Request usage
incidents.description: AWS-specific ListObjectsV2Request for listing objects
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob list methods

incidents.title: S3 GetUrlRequest usage
incidents.description: AWS-specific GetUrlRequest for generating URLs
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Blob URL generation

incidents.title: AWS S3 bucket configuration
incidents.description: Configuration property 'aws.s3.bucket' specific to AWS
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Storage account and container configuration

incidents.title: AWS region configuration
incidents.description: Configuration property 'aws.region' specific to AWS
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure region or endpoint configuration if needed
incidents.azureAlternative: Azure storage accounts are region-specific but typically don't require explicit region configuration

incidents.title: AWS SDK S3 dependency in web module
incidents.description: Maven dependency on software.amazon.awssdk:s3 version 2.25.13
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Storage Blob SDK dependency

incidents.title: AWS SDK S3 dependency in worker module
incidents.description: Maven dependency on software.amazon.awssdk:s3 version 2.25.13
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Storage Blob SDK dependency

incidents.title: RabbitMQ messaging infrastructure
incidents.description: Application uses Spring AMQP with RabbitMQ for asynchronous message processing
incidents.recommendation: Migrate to Azure Service Bus for message queuing

incidents.title: RabbitTemplate usage for sending messages
incidents.description: RabbitTemplate used for sending image processing messages
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus sender

incidents.title: @RabbitListener annotation usage
incidents.description: RabbitMQ-specific listener annotations for message consumption
incidents.recommendation: Replace with @ServiceBusListener annotation

incidents.title: RabbitMQ queue configuration
incidents.description: Queue defined using RabbitMQ-specific QueueBuilder
incidents.recommendation: Remove queue configuration (queues managed in Azure Service Bus)
incidents.azureAlternative: Azure Service Bus queues are created via Azure Portal or Infrastructure as Code

incidents.title: Jackson2JsonMessageConverter configuration
incidents.description: Message converter configured for RabbitMQ JSON serialization
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus handles JSON serialization differently
incidents.azureAlternative: Configure ObjectMapper for Service Bus message body serialization

incidents.title: Manual acknowledgement mode configuration
incidents.description: RabbitMQ listener configured with manual acknowledgement
incidents.recommendation: Azure Service Bus supports different message settlement modes

incidents.title: RabbitMQ connection configuration
incidents.description: RabbitMQ host, port, username, and password configured in application.properties
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus connection string or managed identity

incidents.title: Spring Boot AMQP starter dependency
incidents.description: Maven dependency on spring-boot-starter-amqp for RabbitMQ integration
incidents.recommendation: Replace with Azure Service Bus Spring Cloud starter

incidents.title: Message processing queue name constant
incidents.description: Queue name 'image-processing' hardcoded as constant
incidents.recommendation: Update to use Azure Service Bus queue name from configuration
incidents.azureAlternative: Configure queue name in application properties

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS access credentials in web module
incidents.description: AWS access key and secret key stored as plain text in application.properties
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity or Azure Key Vault for credential management
incidents.azureAlternative: DefaultAzureCredential with managed identity or Azure Key Vault

incidents.title: Hardcoded AWS access credentials in worker module
incidents.description: AWS access key and secret key stored as plain text in application.properties
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Managed Identity or Azure Key Vault for credential management
incidents.azureAlternative: DefaultAzureCredential with managed identity or Azure Key Vault

incidents.title: Hardcoded database credentials
incidents.description: PostgreSQL username and password stored as plain text in application.properties
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault for database credential management or Azure Managed Identity for Azure Database for PostgreSQL
incidents.azureAlternative: Azure Key Vault references or Managed Identity for Azure Database

incidents.title: Hardcoded RabbitMQ credentials
incidents.description: RabbitMQ username and password stored as plain text in application.properties
incidents.recommendation: Use Azure Key Vault or Managed Identity when migrating to Azure Service Bus
incidents.azureAlternative: DefaultAzureCredential for Azure Service Bus authentication

incidents.title: PostgreSQL database dependency
incidents.description: Application uses PostgreSQL database with JDBC connection
incidents.recommendation: Consider Azure Database for PostgreSQL for managed database service
incidents.azureAlternative: Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server

incidents.title: Hibernate DDL auto-update enabled
incidents.description: Database schema auto-update enabled in production configuration
incidents.recommendation: Disable auto-update in production and use proper migration tools
incidents.azureAlternative: Use Flyway or Liquibase for database migrations

incidents.title: Spring Boot version 3.2.1
incidents.description: Application uses Spring Boot 3.2.1 which may have security vulnerabilities
incidents.recommendation: Upgrade to latest Spring Boot 3.x LTS version for security patches and improvements

incidents.title: Missing application monitoring
incidents.description: No application performance monitoring or distributed tracing configured
incidents.recommendation: Add Azure Application Insights for application monitoring

incidents.title: SQL logging enabled
incidents.description: Hibernate SQL logging enabled which may impact performance
incidents.recommendation: Disable SQL logging in production and use Application Insights for query monitoring
incidents.azureAlternative: Azure Application Insights with query performance monitoring

incidents.title: Profile-based configuration strategy
incidents.description: Application uses Spring profiles for dev vs. production configuration
incidents.recommendation: This is a good practice - maintain this pattern when adding Azure-specific profiles

incidents.title: Storage abstraction with StorageService interface
incidents.description: Good design: StorageService interface allows multiple storage implementations
incidents.recommendation: This is a strength - leverage this abstraction when adding Azure Blob Storage implementation

incidents.title: Multi-module Maven project structure
incidents.description: Application separated into web and worker modules
incidents.recommendation: Good architecture - maintain module separation during Azure migration
incidents.azureAlternative: Consider Azure Container Apps for both modules or Azure Functions for worker

recommendations.title: Migrate from AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage
recommendations.description: Replace AWS S3 SDK with Azure Blob Storage SDK across both web and worker modules
tasks: Replace AWS SDK dependency with Azure Storage Blob SDK (com.azure:azure-storage-blob)
Update AwsS3Config to AzureBlobConfig with BlobServiceClient
Refactor AwsS3Service to AzureBlobService implementing existing StorageService interface
Update S3FileProcessingService in worker module to use Azure Blob Storage
Configure Azure Storage account connection string or use Managed Identity
Update application.properties with Azure Storage configuration
Test all storage operations (upload, download, delete, list)

recommendations.title: Migrate from RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus
recommendations.description: Replace Spring AMQP with Azure Service Bus for message queuing
tasks: Replace spring-boot-starter-amqp with spring-cloud-azure-starter-servicebus
Update RabbitConfig to ServiceBusConfig
Replace RabbitTemplate with ServiceBusSenderClient
Replace @RabbitListener with @ServiceBusListener
Configure Azure Service Bus connection string or use Managed Identity
Create 'image-processing' queue in Azure Service Bus
Update message serialization for Service Bus
Test message sending and receiving
benefits: Fully managed service with high availability
Built-in dead-letter queue and retry policies
Support for scheduled messages and sessions

recommendations.title: Implement Azure Managed Identity and Key Vault
recommendations.description: Remove hardcoded credentials and use Azure security services
tasks: Remove hardcoded AWS credentials from application.properties
Configure Azure Managed Identity for the application
Store database credentials in Azure Key Vault
Use DefaultAzureCredential for Azure service authentication
Configure Key Vault references in application configuration
Update documentation for credential management
benefits: Enhanced security with automatic credential rotation

recommendations.title: Migrate to Azure Database for PostgreSQL
recommendations.description: Move PostgreSQL database to Azure managed service
tasks: Provision Azure Database for PostgreSQL Flexible Server
Configure firewall rules and network access
Migrate database schema and data
Update connection strings in application configuration
Enable Managed Identity for database authentication (optional)
Configure backup and high availability

recommendations.title: Add Azure Application Insights
recommendations.description: Implement application performance monitoring and distributed tracing
tasks: Add spring-cloud-azure-starter-monitor dependency
Configure Application Insights connection string
Enable auto-instrumentation for web requests and dependencies
Configure custom metrics and events
Set up alerting rules in Azure
Create Application Insights dashboards

tasks: Migrate AWS S3 to Azure Blob Storage
Migrate RabbitMQ to Azure Service Bus

phase2.title: Security and Identity

Configure Azure Key Vault for secrets

phase3.title: Database and Monitoring

Add Application Insights monitoring

Optimize configuration for Azure
